visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs is seen in a medium shot indoors, wearing a white shirt and a beige sherpa-style vest. She holds up a light gray rectangular cosmetic bag branded 'and us' and introduces it to the camera. (2) She brings out a much larger, black, hanging toiletry bag to show what she currently uses, demonstrating how it unfolds and its bulkiness. (3) The camera focuses closely on the interior of the light gray bag as she begins packing it. She slides various makeup brushes and pencils into specific elastic slots and clear plastic protective pockets. (4) In a series of fast cuts, she populates the internal compartments with numerous items including mascara, eyelash curlers, small palettes, and bottles, showing the bag's high organization capacity. (5) She demonstrates that despite being stuffed, the bag zips up into a compact shape and can stand upright on its own on the wooden table surface. She compares the final size to her previous black bag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice introduces a product over a light, upbeat instrumental track featuring acoustic guitar and a soft electronic beat. (2) A sharp zipping sound is heard as the woman handles cosmetic bags. (3) Continuous, rapid percussive thuds and plastic clicks occur as she organizes items into the new bag, with the speech matching the rhythmic speed of the editing. (4) The speaker's vocal pitch rises excitedly when she finds additional pockets. (5) A long, resonant zipping sound concludes the packing, followed by a bright vocal exclamation 'Oh!!' and a final cheerful 'Hei!' as the music swells slightly.
